notes.title: Major Update: Cloud Saves + Free Surface Movement
notes.notes:
[b]Cloud Save:[/b] With the new cloud save feature, you can upload your save games to share your unique systems with the community or download other players' creations.

[b]Explore Freely:[/b] You can now freely explore the surfaces of all planets! Move around and check out the planetary terrain. Mars, Earth, the Moon and the Jovian Moons have highly realistic terrain based on real planetary terrain data from space agencies. 

[b]Change Object Shape: [/b] You can now alter the axial proportions of objects, making them flatter or wider as you desire. This allows you to make objects more elongated to simulate extreme gravitational pull or rotational speed. Or just to create a fun "Flat Earth"!

notes.title: Update 0.285
notes.notes:
1. From now on, you can create custom particle ring systems which respond to gravity and add them to planets.

2. You can now change celestial bodies into particle balls, simulating the loss of gravitational cohesion (Roche limit breakup)

3. Eclipses will make the sky turn darker now.

notes.title: new Version 0.266
notes.notes:
- Added historic past and future events that you can load directly: comet flybys, solar eclipses and lunar eclipses. You can load them from either the start screen or from the restart menu.
- Added the blue giants Achernar, Acrux, and Hadar, as well as the red giant Aldebaran, in their correct Milky Way locations.
- Added custom clouds (textures menu p.6).  It gives some control over the shape, color and movement of the clouds.
